skills.name: Cyclone Burst
skills.description: Twirls her Naginata to create a powerful whirlwind. Bad effects on enemies.  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (3 sec) *ATK x 2800% Area Damage  *Enemy knockback

skills.name: Moon of the Resting Moth
skills.description: Summons a swarm of moths. Good effects on allies.  *HP x 60% Area Recovery (per sec) (7 sec) *Skill Evade Rate +60% (7 sec) *Skill Resistance +60% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Yashahime
abilities.description: Yashahime Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Enemy Cost Increase2
abilities.description: Gives a set chance of greatly increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed.  This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
